findings.issue: Saving settings reset the fast-loot interval
findings.reproduction: 200 requests in a 25 ms fixture while repeatedly changing zoom
findings.result: The same fixture stays at eight requests until the next 25 ms cycle

findings.issue: Manual interactions could send while the observed socket was not open or a death had ended the session
findings.result: Connecting, closing, closed and terminated-session sends are rejected

findings.issue: Direct native chat bypassed the common send guard after confirmed death
findings.reproduction: Two messages after death while the native state remained 1
findings.result: No messages or mod commands in the same fixture

findings.issue: The source resolver could dereference a missing own-player record before the first position packet
findings.result: No exception before the packet, targeting resumes after it arrives

findings.issue: Callbacks arriving after disposal could block native fire or create more timers
findings.result: Native fire remains available, disposed callbacks allocate no timers or packets

findings.issue: Repeated observation reset timing and counters, and observation after disposal could add listeners
findings.result: Same-socket state is retained and disposed instances attach no observers

findings.issue: Mod-only errors omitted browser exceptions and promise rejections
findings.result: Bounded exception, rejection and resource-failure counters with independent snapshots

findings.issue: Shared AutoFire/AutoThrow, pre-ID death check, invalid line reset, lost range indicator, key capture, touch ownership, inert coefficient, redundant configuration and per-packet adaptive searches
findings.result: Explicit source corrections and regression cases

findings.issue: Multiple terminal callbacks could start duplicate login stages or close a socket while it was connecting
findings.reproduction: Six repeated callbacks were all accepted; success, success, failure started twice and closed once
findings.result: One result is accepted per request; success/failure share ownership, including nested requests
checks: actual native HTTP helper in Chromium and Firefox

findings.issue: Disabling strafe or disposing the mod left its last movement mask on the server
findings.result: Restore the last native movement once while the mod owns it; skip ended and replaced sessions
checks: active playable sockets survive stale entry deadlines in six phases
